name: Alturus' Sanctum
summary: Alturus' Sanctum is a hidden magical refuge accessed through the Master's Cellar beneath Karazhan. Used by Archmage Alturus of the Violet Eye, it serves as an arcane workshop for studying the disturbed magical currents of Deadwind Pass.

sections.title: A Hidden Workshop in the Shadows
sections.body: Tucked away behind a shimmering gateway in the Master's Cellar, Alturus' Sanctum offers a rare sanctuary in the desolate expanse of Deadwind Pass. Within its chamber, Archmage Alturus—an operative of the secretive Violet Eye—conducts delicate research shielded from Karazhan's chaotic energies. During his apprenticeship under Medivh, a young Khadgar would visit Alturus here to collaborate on an artifact given to him by Archmage Antonidas: a fragment of the Archmage's Prismatic Disc. Shielded and windowless, the sanctum remains disconnected from the corrupted soil outside, serving solely as a base for observing the tower's restless magic.

aliases: how to get to alturus sanctum
faq.answer: The sanctum is entered via a portal tucked inside the Master's Cellar, an underground complex beneath Karazhan in Deadwind Pass. Because the chamber lacks windows and is entirely self-contained, its true physical location in Azeroth remains unknown.

Archmage Alturus is a high-ranking mage of Dalaran and a prominent member of the Violet Eye. His primary duty is to monitor Karazhan and investigate the lingering anomalies left behind by the Guardian Medivh.

The Violet Eye is a clandestine sect within the Kirin Tor. Established to keep a watchful eye on Medivh and the magical disturbances surrounding Karazhan, its agents study the tower's fluctuating ley lines and ancient relics.

faq.q: Why did Khadgar visit this sanctum?
faq.answer: While studying as Medivh's apprentice, Khadgar met with Alturus here to examine a fragment of the Archmage's Prismatic Disc, a potent relic entrusted to Khadgar by Archmage Antonidas of Dalaran.

angles.text: For practitioners of the arcane, the sanctum represents the quiet vigilance of the Kirin Tor, demonstrating how high-ranking mages manipulate portals and ley energy right under the shadow of Medivh's tower.
